recognize_zh: 數個大型芽細胞，細胞質豐富呈灰藍色、布滿細小打孔狀空泡，核圓或略凹陷、染色質細緻，部分細胞邊緣有偽足狀突起，這是單核球系芽細胞（monoblasts/promonocytes）的典型外觀，符合 KMT2A 重排的單核球性 AML。
features: Large blasts (roughly 2-3 times RBC diameter) with moderate to low N:C ratio
Round to oval, focally indented or folded nuclei with finely dispersed (lacy) chromatin
Abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with numerous small punched-out vacuoles, some rimming the cell edge
Irregular cytoplasmic margins with blebs and pseudopod-like projections
No Auer rods or coarse granules evident; a single small lymphocyte and scattered normal RBCs in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a population of large blasts in a background of red cells. The blasts have round to indented nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm containing numerous small, punched-out vacuoles, with irregular cytoplasmic blebs and pseudopods. Auer rods are not identified. The morphology is that of monoblasts and promonocytes; findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation, and in the setting of t(9;11)(p22;q23) are consistent with AML with MLLT3::KMT2A.

ddx.dx: Acute myelomonocytic or monoblastic leukemia without KMT2A rearrangement
ddx.vs: Morphology is indistinguishable, so karyotype or FISH for the KMT2A rearrangement is required to classify the case.
Burkitt cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with sharply defined lipid vacuoles, coarser chromatin and a high N:C ratio rather than gray-blue abundant monocytoid cytoplasm with folded nuclei.
CMML shows mature monocytes with clumped chromatin and <20% blasts plus promonocytes, whereas this field is dominated by immature fine-chromatin monoblasts.
Microgranular APL has bilobed or folded nuclei and strong MPO positivity with PML::RARA, whereas monoblasts are nonspecific esterase positive and MPO weak or negative.
